title: Salt dissociation and localized high-concentration solvation at the interface of a fluorinated gel and polymer solid electrolyte
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04078C, Paper
Dechao Zhang, Yuxuan Liu, Dedi Li, Shimei Li, Qi Xiong, Zhaodong Huang, Shixun Wang, Hu Hong, Jiaxiong Zhu, Haiming Lv, Chunyi Zhi
The interfaces between fluorinated gel solid electrolyte (FG-SE) and PVHF-SPE form fast ion transport pathways with high lithium salt dissociation and a local high-concentration (LHC) solvation structure.
